Name: (PFM-JA-MFM) Tiered Artisan Machines
Author: YawrficIndustries
Description:
[size=4]Currently updating to 1.6, along with some requested compatibility. Your patience is appreciated[/size]

This mod adds tiered versions of each main Artisan Machine into the game. Each tier is approximately twice as fast as the previous tier, and uses more costly materials to craft.

Current machines upgraded are Preserves Jars, Kegs, and Casks.
Other machines may be added in the future. If desired, feel free to comment requesting it.

Recipes are obtained in line with the vanilla versions. You'll receive a letter with the recipes from the Ferngill Agroscience Institute of Zuzu City at Farming level 4 (Preserve Jars) and 8 (Kegs), and then after upgrading the farmhouse to level 3 (the cellar - Casks). 

Cask Functioning Locations: (Feel free to request any locations that it should work with)
- Cellar
- Grandpa's Shed ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url])



Thank you to Billieh007 for inspiring me to make this mod with their wonderfully made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14783]PFM Better Kegs Mod[/url], as well as the Stardew Valley discord for the help with getting started modding.
